description: Phase 1+2: Database migrations, model classes, OAuth scopes, and API routes for OCCM Groups. This establishes the entire data layer and routing foundation.
steps: Create migration db/migrate/20260701000001_create_occm_groups.rb with columns: title (string, default:'', not null), description (text, default:'', not null), account_id (references, not null, foreign_key on_delete cascade), approval_required (boolean, default:true, not null), member_count (integer, default:0, not null), timestamps

Create migration db/migrate/20260701000002_create_occm_group_memberships.rb with columns: occm_group_id (references, not null, FK cascade), account_id (references, not null, FK cascade), role (integer, default:2, not null), state (integer, default:0, not null), timestamps. Add unique index on [occm_group_id, account_id]

Create migration db/migrate/20260701000003_create_occm_group_statuses.rb with columns: occm_group_id (references, not null, FK cascade), status_id (references, not null, FK cascade), account_id (references, not null, FK cascade), created_at (datetime, not null). Add unique index on [occm_group_id, status_id]

Create migration db/migrate/20260701000004_create_occm_group_reports.rb with columns: occm_group_id (references, FK cascade), account_id (references, FK cascade), target_account_id (bigint, not null), status_ids (bigint array, default:[]), comment (text, default:''), category (integer, default:0, not null), action_taken_at (datetime), action_taken_by_account_id (bigint), timestamps. Add indexes and foreign keys for target_account_id and action_taken_by_account_id
Create migration db/migrate/20260701000005_create_occm_group_dm_rooms.rb (placeholder) with columns: occm_group_id (references, FK cascade), title (string, default:'', not null), timestamps

Create app/models/occm_group.rb - include Paginable, belongs_to :account, has_many associations, validations (title presence/max 100, description max 500), validate_group_limit (GROUP_LIMIT=50). Use owned_groups pattern from account associations

Create app/models/occm_group_membership.rb - belongs_to :occm_group, belongs_to :account, enum :role (admin:0, moderator:1, user:2) with prefix, enum :state (pending:0, active:1, rejected:2) with prefix, validates uniqueness of account_id scoped to occm_group_id, scopes: active, pending, admins, moderators, with_moderation_role
Create app/models/occm_group_status.rb - include Paginable, belongs_to :occm_group, belongs_to :status, belongs_to :account, validates uniqueness of status_id scoped to occm_group_id

Create app/models/occm_group_report.rb - belongs_to :occm_group, belongs_to :account, belongs_to :target_account (class_name Account), belongs_to :action_taken_by_account (class_name Account, optional), enum :category (other:0, spam:1, harassment:2, off_topic:3, rule_violation:4) with prefix, validates comment length max 1000, scopes: unresolved, resolved
Create app/models/occm_group_dm_room.rb - belongs_to :occm_group, validates title presence/max 100

Create app/models/concerns/status/occm_group_visibility.rb - extend ActiveSupport::Concern, define visible_to_occm_group_member?(account) method that checks if status has occm_group_status record and if so verifies active membership
Modify app/models/status.rb - add has_one :occm_group_status, dependent: :destroy and include Status::OccmGroupVisibility
Add read:occm_groups and write:occm_groups to config/initializers/doorkeeper.rb optional_scopes list

Add OCCM Groups routes to config/routes/api.rb inside namespace :v1 block: resources :occm_groups with nested members (index, create, destroy + pending/approve/reject), moderators (create, destroy), statuses (create, destroy), timelines (show), reports (index, create + resolve), and transfer action
acceptance_criteria: All model files load without errors (bundle exec rails runner 'OccmGroup; OccmGroupMembership; OccmGroupStatus; OccmGroupReport; OccmGroupDmRoom')
Routes are properly defined (rails routes grep occm shows all expected endpoints)
Doorkeeper config includes the new scopes
Model validations work correctly (title presence, length limits, uniqueness constraints)
Enums are properly defined with correct integer mappings
Scopes return correct results (active, pending, admins, moderators, with_moderation_role, unresolved, resolved)
verification: Run: ruby -c on all new Ruby files to verify syntax
Run: bundle exec rspec spec/models/occm_group_spec.rb (after specs are created in later feature)
findings: Bundle install requires libidn-devel system package. Full Rails environment cannot load without libvips (not available in sandbox). Verified via ruby -c syntax checks, rubocop (all pass), and isolated model loading tests. All 17 files pass rubocop with no offenses.
